rules.label: Sliding Scale Financial Assistance Program
rules.quote: You may be able to get financial assistance if you do not have insurance, are underinsured, or if it would be a financial hardship to pay in full the expected out of pocket expenses for services at Montrose Regional Health.

notes: Policy references a sliding scale based on Federal Poverty Guidelines and household size/income but does not specify exact percentages or categories in the summary text.
Policy mentions AGB (amounts generally billed) protection: no person eligible for financial assistance will be charged more for medically necessary care than AGB.
Policy lists service exclusions not typically eligible for financial assistance, including transplants, cosmetic services, and other services.
Policy states financial assistance applications must be submitted to the Business Office but does not specify a time limit for applying.
Policy does not specify any timing for application submission, ECA restrictions, or first statement timing.
sliding_scale_fap may leave out a condition: policy requires meeting sliding scale based on household income per FPL guidelines
